Real Extension Smoke Test

Selection Overlay in the Content Script World

Plain text is the most durable format we have. It has survived every operating system, every editor, and every decade of hardware churn, because it asks for nothing but a way to read bytes.

This page does not mock the extension runtime. After load, a script selects part of the first paragraph, which fires selectionchange inside the content script and should reveal the cairn-red trigger at the end of the selection.

如果是真实扩展环境，选区右下应出现圆形「译」按钮；否则说明 content script 注入或 Shadow DOM 渲染不生效。
